scripts.label: Difficult defense
scripts.text: Well found. Of the moves we checked, this was the only one that kept the position playable. The other choices were losing.

scripts.label: Abandoned defender
scripts.text: This move takes away a needed defender. The other side can now capture the piece it was protecting. Before moving a defender, check what it leaves behind.

scripts.label: Forced mate allowed
scripts.text: This move allows a forced checkmate. Even the best defense cannot stop that continuation. Let’s follow it carefully, one move at a time.

scripts.label: Fork found
scripts.text: The idea is a fork in the continuation. One piece attacks two or more targets at once. Follow the line and watch for the moment those attacks come together.
